visualCharacteristics.purpose: Closing bar of an article: back-to-overview link plus topic tag pills
visualCharacteristics.layout: Back link left, tag pills right-aligned in one row from 960px, ruled below; stacked on mobile
notable: Left arrow drawn before the back link

contentPattern.structure: One row: a cell with the single back link, a cell with the tag links (list or paragraphs); either cell may be omitted

usage: Use at the foot of articles and press releases to return to the overview and show the topics.
reuseGuidance: Fits one back link plus a handful of tags; use tag-list alone when there is no back link.
